item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 23/Dec/2021
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A band of clouds will cover southern China in the next few days. An intense winter monsoon is expected to reach Guangdong on Christmas Day. The weather will become cold appreciably, and it will be windy over the region in the following couple of days. Meanwhile, an upper-air disturbance will also affect the region. It will be cloudy with rain over the coast of Guangdong. With the monsoon moderating gradually and the upper-air disturbance departing, the weather will improve over the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week, but it will remain cool in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.
